title: Austin's Private Talks on Land, Law, Staff
summary:
*   Austin City Council held a special closed-door meeting.
*   Discussions focused on sensitive topics including potential land acquisitions, ongoing legal cases, and personnel matters, such as Board and Commission appointments.
*   No official actions or policy decisions were made or announced during this session.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
SPECIAL CALLED COUNCIL MEETING - May 06, 1986
CENTRAL LIBRARY - 4TH FLOOR - 4 P.M.
Council Chambers, 307 West Second Street, Austin, Texas City Council
FrankC.Cooksey
Mayor
John Trevino, Jr.
Mayor Pro Tern
Council Members

Sally Shipman

City Manager
Memorandum To:
Mayor Cooksey called to order the meeting of the Council scheduled for 4:00 p.m.* noting
the absence of
Councilmembers Rose and Urdy.
The Mayor announced Council would go into Executive Session pursuant to Article 6252-17,
Texas Revised Civil Statues Annotated, to discuss matters of land acquisition* litigation
and for personnel matters.
No official action of the City Council will be taken on any of these matters unless such
item is specifically listed on the agenda.
a. Board and Commission Appointments -
Section 2, Paragraph g.
Council recessed for executive session at 4:33 p.m. until 6:10 p.m., at which time they
adjourned their Special Called Meeting.
